title: Orbiting Room
tagline: Rearrange one room as the window drifts around the planet.
description: A quiet room floats in a slow orbit. Move furniture into the light, collect postcards from passing satellites, and let the day cycle do the rest.
prompt: Build a self-contained browser game called Orbiting Room. A quiet room floats in a slow orbit. Move furniture into the light, collect postcards from passing satellites, and let the day cycle do the rest.
